title: Light Springy Malaysian Hake Satay
description: A sweet and savory Malaysian-inspired dish perfect for a post-workout snack or light meal. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe features succulent hake skewers grilled to perfection.
instructions: Cut the hake fillets into 1-inch pieces and thread them onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a blender or food processor, combine rice vinegar, coconut sugar, Gochujang, garlic, ginger, and lemongrass. Blend until smooth.
Heat the coconut oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the blended sauce and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Brush the sauce onto both sides of the hake skewers.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Grill the hake skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the grilled hake skewers with toasted peanuts, lime wedges, cucumber slices, and cilantro sprigs.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
